title: Core: AS2 EventDispatcher pattern (addEventListener)
description: Test compilation of Flash 8 EventDispatcher-style patterns: EventDispatcher.initialize(obj), obj.addEventListener('event', handler), obj.removeEventListener('event', handler), obj.dispatchEvent({type:'event'}). Also test the alternative AsBroadcaster pattern: AsBroadcaster.initialize(obj), obj.addListener(listener), obj.removeListener(listener), obj.broadcastMessage('onLoad', arg). Each should compile without error.
